ms.report:
I am not providing any more information as what has been provided is beyond sufficient (3x more detail provided in other final milestones, that have been approved in this fund). We have spoken to Roberta from the Catalyst team upon last refusal, have put all and more recommendations in place, and we are in agreement that after those additions, this suffices from a closeout report and video perspective. Add narration to closeout video, added
We've provided all that we can from a media and documentation standpoint proving beyond sufficient evidence that we hosted a networking event in Singapore at Token2049 -- it shows signage with Project Catalyst branding, massive amounts of people and production, multiple Cardano community members from Hong Kong community to Lenna from Clay Nation to Champ Medici to ourselves at Rare Evo,, along with blockchain ecosystem leads from brands like Ledger and Animoca Brands. There is video of me on stage. There are videos of us at the conference highlighting the experience with much of the footage surrounding Cardano booths. There is the vlog sizzle reel, the vlog narrated as a closeout video, and various clips. There are pictures of the event, there is an event page, a full breakdown of the entire agenda with graphics, there are screenshots of nearly 2k people signing up, there are X posts from us and others. There are other highly produced videos from other companies who were at the event, like our local co-hosts, Smobler.
